## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Turkish-language 3D mining incremental game for phones and tablets, with character choice, progression, tools, a large map, and varied ores.

- Build a complete, playable Turkish-language 3D mining incremental game for phones and tablets, with character choice, progression, tools, a large map, and varied ores.

## Requirements
- User requested a “3D mandecilik oyunu” with broad development trees, character-directed incremental gameplay, varied characters and mining tools, a large map, and diverse ores for phone/tablet.

- Implemented a Three.js browser game with touch joystick and mining button, keyboard controls, Turkish UI, upgrade trees, multiple miners/tools/ores, quests, region travel, and localStorage persistence.
